name: workflow-audit-native-overlap-redundancy
title: workflow-audit: native Trellis overlap and redundancy
description: Audit the local workflow product for redundant or conflicting overlap with native Trellis 0.5.0-rc.5 behavior. Refined conclusion: current installer does not duplicate native Trellis agents; docs/workflows remediation has aligned maintainer docs, commands wording, native-agent ownership, fresh-baseline carrier names, and Codex skills directory boundaries; .trellis/spec contract wording now matches the implementation for Codex skills scope and Trellis-native agent ownership. The remaining evidence gap is formal install and post-install upgrade-compat.py --check through a non-Codex handoff or explicitly approved direct-shell execution.

notes: Docs/workflows remediation completed for the target maintainer docs and residual commands wording. Runtime command exit statuses remain recorded for trellis -v, detect-embed-state.py --json, and install-workflow.py --dry-run. The boundary matrix, hidden-directory checklist, platform README files, embedded NL routing text, installer/upgrade comments, and brainstorm process table now treat trellis-research/trellis-implement/trellis-check as Trellis-native, use current fresh-baseline carriers continue/finish-work and trellis-continue/trellis-finish-work, and keep start/record-session only in legacy compatibility, historical example, or fallback implementation wording. The .trellis/spec/scripts/workflow-installer-upgrade-contracts.md Codex skills scope drift has been remediated: shared workflow skills deploy to .agents/skills/ only, .codex/skills/ is duplicate-cleanup scope, optional disabled entries are handled where they exist, and active baseline patches target trellis-continue/trellis-finish-work. The same spec now treats trellis-research/trellis-implement/trellis-check as Trellis-native and limits workflow responsibility to legacy bare-name migration. Formal install and upgrade-compat.py --check remain a Codex handoff evidence gap.

review_followups: Keep formal install and upgrade-compat.py --check as an evidence gap until a non-Codex handoff or explicitly approved direct shell run completes.
